node.statement: Pre-application completion of the raw-call record. Using only the component data and bounds of nodes 1.2-1.4, first form the complete def-maincb-raw-call datum, before invoking lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement. In the branch m>1, record: the Stage-1 tag; the supplied input map w; source C^{m+1}; explicit target corner A (the target ambient of the sum-map conclusion); base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; the literal sum map v_old plus v_fresh and its fixed amplifications; target ambient defect epsilon; and d_raw:=D_1*t_1. In the branch m=1, record: the same tag and input map; source C^2=C^{m+1}; explicit target corner A_fresh=S_{P_fresh}; base scale t_1 and no post-helper scale; v_fresh with its fixed amplifications; target ambient defect L*epsilon; and d_raw:=C_pair*L*epsilon, the defect parameter already supplied by node 1.3. The definition of a raw call expressly says that recording d_raw asserts no inclusion theorem, so entering D_1*t_1 in the m>1 record before applying the external lemma is data entry, not circular reasoning. The recorded ambient defects epsilon and L*epsilon are at most t_1, and every remaining antecedent is supplied and bounded by nodes 1.2-1.4.
